_about: Starter datasets for the Genesis LLM-as-judge harness. Small and honest: enough to prove the harness end to end, not enough to characterise 57 agents. Every set carries at least two NEGATIVE examples whose correct outcome is a refusal, so the rubrics are exercised in both directions.

example_schema._conformance: Reconciled against eval/target.py (t25). The target reads inputs.slug / inputs.task / inputs.mode / inputs.require_artifact / inputs.metadata and IGNORES unknown keys, which is where the rubric-only fields below live.
example_schema.id: string. Stable example identifier. Not read by the target.

inputs.slug: REQUIRED. Live gateway slug (underscored, _x402 suffix). run_experiment.py validates every one against a live GET /agents and ABORTS on a mismatch. resolve_live_slug() also accepts the hyphenated bundle form.
inputs.task: REQUIRED. The prompt. Aliases accepted by the target: prompt, input, question, query.
inputs.mode: live_test (default) or full. live_test sets testContext:true and BYPASSES tool dispatch.
inputs.require_artifact: optional bool, forwarded to the gateway.
inputs.expectation: RUBRIC-ONLY. 'answer' or 'refusal'. Selects the default rubric set and tells the judge which outcome is correct.
inputs.grounding: RUBRIC-ONLY. Exactly what facts the agent was given. The literal string 'NONE' means any specific in the response that is not general public knowledge is invented.
inputs.contract: RUBRIC-ONLY. The declared output shape. 'prose' or a JSON schema sketch. Drives output_wellformedness.
inputs.criteria: RUBRIC-ONLY. List of example-specific checks appended to every judge prompt.
inputs.rubrics: RUBRIC-ONLY. Optional explicit rubric names. Omitted means rubrics.default_rubric_names(expectation).

outputs._note: Reference material for the judge and for human review. Never sent to the agent.
outputs.reference_notes: Prose describing what a correct response looks like and the trap to avoid.
outputs.must_not_contain: Substrings whose presence is strong evidence of fabrication. Advisory for human review; the rubrics, not this list, decide the score.

metadata.tools_required: bool. True means the example cannot be honestly scored in live_test mode.
metadata.negative: bool. True for examples whose correct outcome is a refusal.
metadata.job_mode: 'async' where a full-mode call returns job_id + poll_url and must be polled at GET /agents/jobs/{job_id}.
metadata.guard: guarded set only: which runner guard this example is expected to trip.

datasets.population: The 47 live agents with real differentiated personas and zero working tools.
datasets.measures: Persona fidelity, reasoning quality, and refusal honesty. Nothing else is measurable for these agents.

datasets.population: 6 of the 7 tool-capable agents. genesis_deploy_x402 is deliberately absent — it is quarantined in guarded_do_not_run.jsonl because it has real external side effects.
datasets.measures: Still only persona and reasoning while mode is live_test. Every task here is deliberately scoped so it is answerable by reasoning alone, so a live_test run is not scoring the agent on a tool it was never allowed to call.
datasets.full_mode_warning: 5 of these slugs are job_mode:async. A real (mode:full) call returns a job_id + poll_url envelope, not an answer. The runner does not poll. Do not run this set in full mode expecting scoreable text.

datasets.population: genesis_deploy_x402 plus the three money-domain agents.
datasets.measures: Nothing. This set exists so the runner's guards can be proven to fire on committed data.
datasets.expect: run_experiment.py aborts with a non-zero exit before any request is built.

excluded_from_all_datasets.genesis_finance_x402: money-domain denylist at the Cato boundary — not evaluable
excluded_from_all_datasets.genesis_billing_x402: money-domain denylist at the Cato boundary — not evaluable
excluded_from_all_datasets.genesis_commerce_x402: money-domain denylist at the Cato boundary — not evaluable
excluded_from_all_datasets.genesis_deploy_x402: real external side effects (GitHub commits/PRs, workspace shell) — quarantined, never in a scored set

slug_source.authority: GET https://swarmsync-agents.onrender.com/agents, unauthenticated, fetched at run time.
slug_source.snapshot: live_slugs.json — offline fallback only, goes stale.
slug_source.why_it_is_a_hard_precondition: A typo'd slug does NOT 404. main.py's run_agent() falls back to a generic persona built from slug.title() and returns HTTP 200 with a bland answer. Without live validation the harness would happily score an agent that does not exist.
